note: The leaf reads 'Minerӕ' and 'ernehrende'; Y misreads 'Minoræ' and modernizes the spelling ('ihr', 'Ursach', 'ernährende'), but the sense is intact.
Y drops 'creaturis' from 'nihil creaturis uisibile, ut Fortunatus', which changes the sense, and alters the printed 'Marcellius' to 'Marcellus'.
X keeps the Hebrew as printed ('קירון עור פנים') and reads 'sit'; Y normalizes the Hebrew to 'קֶרֶן עוֹר פָּנִים' and twice gives 'fit' for 'sit', though Y correctly has the Greek 'ὃς τις'.
The leaf prints 'otio is ali solet' and 'quibusdam'; X omits 'is' and gives 'quibusdā'. Otherwise the two are near-identical.
The body texts are identical; Y only adds a spurious '<sig>s</sig>' taken from show-through and bolds 'Deum'.
Y matches 'quartæ quintæue partis', 'Conseruæ', 'Enulæ' and 'I. Q.'; X drops the '-ue' ('quartæ quintæ') and gives 'Conferuæ', 'Enula' and 'pleurifibus'.
Y collapses the subscript leaf numbers into wrong figures ('24V, 50V' for 'X4v, X5v'; '288 V' for '21₈v'; 'IV 11, 12 & 13'), which misstates the collation.
The leaf reads 'kulminirt', 'frugi', 'Aukto=rität' and 'funfzigsten'; Y's 'fulminirt' and 'fruggi' are wrong words, and its header reads 'Bom' for 'Vom'.
The leaf reads 'ductore Bor-bonio'; X garbles the name as 'Bo-bonio' and leaves HTML '&' entities. Y is otherwise faithful.
The leaf reads '曰干扞也…青裘豹褎麛裘青豻褎豹取制服豻取守也'; X has '干豻也', '豹豻裘青豻裘' and '豹取守也', which change the gloss. X's page number '百十一' is also wrong.
